description: Test whether conserved polar residues of IRG-2 form a spatially clustered, exposed candidate functional site
code:
import requests, json, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, mannwhitneyu

cdf=pd.read_csv("/agent/jobs/29937715-f3de-4c80-a203-a9ca6414aa2d/provenance/irg2_conservation_per_residue.csv")
pdbtxt=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O16224-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
CA=[l for l in pdbtxt.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
ca=np.array([[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])] for l in CA])
# side-chain centroid per residue (better for site geometry)
from collections import defaultdict
sc=defaultdict(list)
for l in pdbtxt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        at=l[12:16].strip(); ri=int(l[22:26])
        if at not in ("N","C","O"): sc[ri].append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
cen={k:np.mean(v,axis=0) for k,v in sc.items()}

core=cdf[(cdf.ncov>=20)&(cdf.pLDDT>=70)].copy()
POLAR=set("DEHKRSTYNQC")
cand=core[(core.frac_identical_to_IRG2>=0.50)&(core.aa.isin(POLAR))]
print("Conserved (>=50% identity to IRG-2) polar/charged residues in confident regions:")
print(cand[['pos','aa','frac_identical_to_IRG2','ncov','nbrs10A','pLDDT']].to_string(index=False))

pos=cand.pos.values
P=np.array([cen[p] for p in pos])
D=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None,:],axis=-1)
print("\nPairwise side-chain-centroid distances < 10 A among these residues:")
found=[]
for i in range(len(pos)):
    for jx in range(i+1,len(pos)):
        if D[i,jx]<10:
            found.append((pos[i],cand.aa.values[i],pos[jx],cand.aa.values[jx],round(D[i,jx],1)))
for f in sorted(found,key=lambda x:x[4]): print("   ",f)
print("n pairs <10A:", len(found), "of", len(pos)*(len(pos)-1)//2)

# largest connected cluster at 10 A
import networkx as nx
G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(pos)
for a,_,b,_,d in found: G.add_edge(a,b)
comps=sorted(nx.connected_components(G), key=len, reverse=True)
print("\nconnected components (10 A linkage):", [sorted(c) for c in comps if len(c)>1])

# exposure of the biggest cluster members
big=sorted(comps[0]) if comps and len(comps[0])>1 else []
print("largest cluster:", big, " nbrs10A:", [int(core[core.pos==p].nbrs10A.iloc[0]) for p in big])

# ---------- FIGURE ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.6))
ax=axes[0]
sizes=20+200*core.frac_identical_to_IRG2.fillna(0)
s=ax.scatter(core.nbrs10A, core.frac_identical_to_IRG2, c=core.pLDDT, cmap='viridis', s=35, vmin=60, vmax=100)
plt.colorbar(s,ax=ax,label='pLDDT')
rho,p=spearmanr(core.nbrs10A, core.frac_identical_to_IRG2)
ax.set_xlabel('Burial (CA neighbours within 10 A)')
ax.set_ylabel('Fraction of 110 family members identical to IRG-2')
ax.set_title(f'IRG2_ab family conservation is highest in buried positions\nSpearman rho = {rho:.2f}, p = {p:.1e}, n = {len(core)} residues',fontsize=10)
for _,r in core.sort_values('frac_identical_to_IRG2',ascending=False).head(8).iterrows():
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{int(r.pos)}",(r.nbrs10A,r.frac_identical_to_IRG2),fontsize=8,xytext=(3,3),textcoords='offset points')

ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(cdf.pos, cdf.frac_identical_to_IRG2.fillna(0), color='#4a7ab5', width=1.0)
ax.plot(cdf.pos, cdf.pLDDT/100, color='#c0392b', lw=1, alpha=.8, label='pLDDT / 100')
ax.axvspan(70,197,color='#ffd27f',alpha=.3)
ax.text(133,1.02,'Pfam IRG2_N (70-197)',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#7a5600')
ax.set_xlabel('IRG-2 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Conservation / scaled pLDDT')
ax.set_title('Per-residue conservation across 110 nematode IRG2_ab proteins\n(query-anchored structural alignment from Foldseek)',fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(1,278); ax.set_ylim(0,1.12); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
